ينجذب (form VII)
# يَنْجَذِبُ (yanjaḏibu) /jan.d͡ʒa.ði.bu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْجَذَبَ (injaḏaba)
# يُنْجَذَبُ (yunjaḏabu) /jun.d͡ʒa.ða.bu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِنْجَذَبَ (injaḏaba)
# يَنْجَذِبَ (yanjaḏiba) /jan.d͡ʒa.ði.ba/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْجَذَبَ (injaḏaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
